Agent onboarding: signup URL, auto-created key, free-credit budget and the 402 top-up path. Attribution links refreshed.

Initial release of google-play-store-api skill.

- Search Google Play for Android apps and games by keyword.
- Retrieve a complete Play Store listing with real install counts, permissions, Data safety table, and more (via package name or Play URL).
- Page through detailed reviews with cursor-based pagination.
- All endpoints return structured JSON; each call uses 2 credits.
- Supports interface language (hl) and country (gl) selection.
- Requires SCAVIO_API_KEY for access.
